claims.text: Advanced machine-learning techniques are the proposed intervention.
Advanced machine learning can improve the accuracy of melting-temperature determination in high-entropy alloys.
Advanced machine learning can improve the accuracy of determining enthalpy and entropy of fusion in high-entropy alloys.
Advanced machine learning can improve the accuracy of determining volume change upon melting in high-entropy alloys.
Advanced machine learning can improve the accuracy of determining liquid thermodynamic properties in high-entropy alloys.
Advanced machine learning can improve the efficiency of determining the listed melting and liquid-state properties relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Machine-learning models mediate the proposed improvement by improving prediction and estimation of thermodynamic properties.
The proposed approach applies to high-entropy alloys with varying compositions and temperature ranges.
The approach is limited by the availability of training data.
Machine-learning model bias may limit the approach.
Accuracy would be evaluated by comparing machine-learning predictions with independent reference data.
